_about: The STEMEd+ sites whose deadline calendars are combined here. Each build downloads every calendar (ics); if one cannot be reached, its deadlines from the last published deadlines.json are kept so nothing disappears for a day. old_ids: calendar and RSS names a site used before it was merged; the same feeds are also written under those names so existing subscriptions keep working.
title: STEMEd+ Deadlines
tagline: Every deadline from across STEMEd+ Commons in one place: funding calls, conference proposals and registration, and professional development for K-12 teachers, informal educators, college faculty and instructors, and graduate students and postdocs. Subscribe once to get them all in your calendar.
